catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: NCCP v4 p2 excludes moderate or severe hepatic impairment, while p3 Table 2 permits Child–Pugh A/B without adjustment and C at 67% of original dose. Current EMA SmPC also permits moderate impairment and a one-third reduction for severe impairment. This internal NCCP conflict requires Consultant/pharmacy resolution; no automatic hepatic dose is calculated. NCCP v4 p3 expects no renal adjustment even below CrCl 30 mL/min or on haemodialysis. EMA SmPC 4.2 cautions that severe impairment has no clinical experience; severe renal impairment/dialysis require individual specialist review.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.source_retrieval_method: Fresh official PDF download; extracted text and visually inspected NCCP pages 3–5
metadata.source_version_change: Version remains 4; fresh v4 PDF dated 23/02/2026 and EMA product information checked 2026-10-29. Previous encoding did not implement all v4 pathways.
source_conflicts: NCCP v4 p2 excludes moderate or severe hepatic impairment, while p3 Table 2 permits Child–Pugh A/B without adjustment and C at 67% of original dose. Current EMA SmPC also permits moderate impairment and a one-third reduction for severe impairment. This internal NCCP conflict requires Consultant/pharmacy resolution; no automatic hepatic dose is calculated.

NCCP v4 p3 expects no renal adjustment even below CrCl 30 mL/min or on haemodialysis. EMA SmPC 4.2 cautions that severe impairment has no clinical experience; severe renal impairment/dialysis require individual specialist review.
NCCP 00340a is post-crizotinib ALK-positive advanced NSCLC. The EMA licence also includes first-line disease; that does not expand this NCCP suite or establish reimbursement.

The standard current schedule is 450 mg once daily with food. Historical 750 mg fasting trial results cannot be presented as trials of the current fed schedule. Only a clinician-directed inability-to-eat switch uses the specific alternate schedule; patients must not alternate fed and fasted dosing.

NCCP v4 Table 3 does not specify a CTCAE edition. Preserve clinically confirmed grades without labelling them CTCAE v5. The source glucose threshold is strictly >250 mg/dL, not a rounded 13.9 mmol/L threshold.
metadata.treatment_intent: Disease control in advanced ALK-positive NSCLC

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Consultant/pharmacy review is required for every dose change. Do not multiply organ, interaction or toxicity reductions. Source conflicts are retained explicitly; a hold or permanent stop overrides a possible future restart.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00340 Version 4. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Reconciled v0.84.25; unresolved source conflict and independent clinical/pharmacy review pending.

indications.description: Adults with ALK-positive advanced non-small cell lung cancer previously treated with crizotinib.
indications.biomarker: ALK positive by accurate validated assay

treatment.schedule_summary: Ceritinib 450 mg orally once daily with food, continuously until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. No planned rest week; use the authorised prescription.

action.message: Avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors. eligibility: Adults with ALK-positive advanced NSCLC previously treated with crizotinib (00340a), validated ALK assay.
ECOG 0–2 and adequate organ function; Consultant Medical Oncologist initiates treatment.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity; ALK-negative disease; congenital long-QT syndrome; pregnancy or breastfeeding.
NCCP moderate/severe hepatic exclusion conflicts with its organ-dose table: resolve explicitly before initiation or restart.
monitoring: Baseline validated ALK test; FBC, renal/liver profile including ALT/AST/bilirubin, lipase/amylase, fasting glucose and ECG; pulse/BP and GI, pancreatic, cardiac and pulmonary assessment.
FBC/renal profile and fasting glucose every 4 weeks; glucose more often if abnormal or diabetes.
Liver tests every 2 weeks for first 3 months, then monthly and more often if abnormal.
ECG after 1 month then as clinically indicated; periodic ECG/electrolytes for cardiac risks or fluid loss, regular pulse/BP.
Lipase/amylase periodically as indicated. Assess infection, breathing, vision, neuropathy, oedema, GI effects, adherence and interactions. Disease imaging per Consultant plan.
dose_modifications: With-food dose ladder: 450 mg →300 mg →150 mg daily →discontinue. Do not re-escalate toxicity-reduced doses; pharmacokinetic interaction changes require their separate plan.
Hold for >3 weeks due to toxicity: consider discontinuation. No restart is automatically authorised.

NCCP v4 p2 excludes moderate or severe hepatic impairment, while p3 Table 2 permits Child–Pugh A/B without adjustment and C at 67% of original dose. Current EMA SmPC also permits moderate impairment and a one-third reduction for severe impairment. This internal NCCP conflict requires Consultant/pharmacy resolution; no automatic hepatic dose is calculated.

NCCP v4 p3 expects no renal adjustment even below CrCl 30 mL/min or on haemodialysis. EMA SmPC 4.2 cautions that severe impairment has no clinical experience; severe renal impairment/dialysis require individual specialist review.
NCCP 00340a is post-crizotinib ALK-positive advanced NSCLC. The EMA licence also includes first-line disease; that does not expand this NCCP suite or establish reimbursement.

The standard current schedule is 450 mg once daily with food. Historical 750 mg fasting trial results cannot be presented as trials of the current fed schedule. Only a clinician-directed inability-to-eat switch uses the specific alternate schedule; patients must not alternate fed and fasted dosing.

NCCP v4 Table 3 does not specify a CTCAE edition. Preserve clinically confirmed grades without labelling them CTCAE v5. The source glucose threshold is strictly >250 mg/dL, not a rounded 13.9 mmol/L threshold.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00340 v4 p5 and current NCCP oral classification: moderate-to-high; individual daily oral prophylaxis under local policy.

Early diarrhoea/nausea management and hydration; report persistent symptoms and inability to eat.
Review all medicines including grapefruit and St John’s wort avoidance; do not self-switch food schedule.

administration.notes: With food at the same time daily. Dose reductions are 150 mg steps; do not alternate fed and fasting schedules.
